    if k > len(q):
        print("NO")
        return

    if len(set(q[:k])) < k:
        print("NO")
        return
    
    # Create the sequence
    sequence = []
    used_chars = set()
    i = 0

        j = i + 1
        while j < len(q) and q[j] == start_char:
            j += 1
        
        sequence.append(q[i:j])
        i = j
    
    if ''.join(sequence) != q:
        print("NO")

    print("YES")
    for s in sequence:
